'''July 2000 Sea Girt tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sea Girt, NJ on 1 July 2000. [[Chris Gogolen]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d964">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pad964/ 7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pa], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pad964/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Sea Girt, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Gogolen]]
